title.en: An Act Authorizing Judges of the Courts of First Instance and Land Registration, and the Members of the Code Committee to Take their Vacations At Any Time During the Year Under Certain Conditions, With the Approval of the Secretary of Finance and Justice.

text.en:
The five months' vacation to which judges of the Court of First Instance and of the Court of
Land Registration and members of the Code Committee are entitled every three years by virtue of existing law
may be taken at any time during the year with the consent of the Secretary of Finance and Justice without
necessarily including the court vacation: Provided, That no judge or member of the Code Committee shall
enjoy this privilege without being on duty during such court vacation.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 1, 1913.
